subject.title: Agent confabulates completed actions on Telegram surface — same config works reliably on Claude Code/Codex

question: Should OpenClaw treat this Telegram side-effect-confabulation report as plugin-only under current hooks, or add a narrow core outbound `runId` correlation seam so verifier plugins can gate exact turns safely?
rationale: The broad verifier request already has a plugin-scope maintainer decision, but current source documents an outbound run-correlation gap that may block safe exact-turn verification under concurrency.

options.title: Plugin Policy Plus Narrow Seam
options.body: Keep claim-verification behavior out of core, but add a focused plugin API fix if exact outbound `runId` correlation is required for safe Telegram/direct verification.

options.title: Plugin Only
options.body: Treat current `sessionKey` correlation as sufficient and ask affected users to publish or install a ClawHub verifier without further core changes.

options.title: Built-In Core Verifier
options.body: Make OpenClaw own success-claim verification directly, accepting the new policy and configuration surface in core.

recommendation.title: Plugin Policy Plus Narrow Seam
recommendation.body: Keep claim-verification behavior out of core, but add a focused plugin API fix if exact outbound `runId` correlation is required for safe Telegram/direct verification.

likelyOwner.reason: He made the clearest related product-boundary decision on runtime claim verification versus ClawHub/plugin scope.
